# Replication and Reproduction Materials for: Embracing Emergence

This directory contains materials that future researchers could use to run their own interviews, as well as the full results and metadata from our own interviews.

## Interview Data

| File | Contents |
|------|----------|
| [pre_screening_questionnaire.md](pre_screening_questionnaire.md) | Pre-screening questionnaire administered to participants before scheduling interviews |
| [interview_questions.md](interview_questions.md) | Semi-structured interview protocol, including introduction script and question list |
| [participant_demographics.md](participant_demographics.md) | Participant demographics: occupation, programming frequency, CS background, primary stack, and auxiliary tools (N=15) |

## Thematic Analysis

Our code taxonomy is a single table with a brief listing of all codes and their sub-categories used in our thematic analysis. The two codebook files group codes into themes: [codebook_part1_characterization.md](codebook_part1_characterization.md) covers our deductive codes (pre-determined) and [codebook_part2_inductive.md](codebook_part2_inductive.md) covers our inductive codes (developed during analysis).

| File | Contents |
|------|----------|
| [code_taxonomy.md](code_taxonomy.md) | Full code taxonomy with sub-categories and enumerated values for each code |
| [codebook_part1_characterization.md](codebook_part1_characterization.md) | Qualitative codebook Part 1: deductive codes for computational experiment characterization (19 codes) |
| [codebook_part2_inductive.md](codebook_part2_inductive.md) | Qualitative codebook Part 2: inductive codes for social performance, loss of context, tooling bottlenecks, and constraints (13 codes) |

## Tags

The [`/tags`](tags/) directory contains the qualitative codes applied to each participant's interview transcript. To understand what each code means, consult the codebooks above before exploring the tags. There is one CSV file per participant (e.g., `P01.csv`, `P02.csv`, …), each with three columns:

| Column | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `participant` | Participant ID |
| `tag` | The code applied, using dot notation for sub-categories (e.g., `versionControl.system`, `dataAcquisition.api`) |
| `content` | The transcript excerpt that the tag was applied to |
